verdict.rationale: Docs describe a direct feedback-to-task pipeline: a widget captures user feedback, submissions route to a project or org Feedback list, and an agent then reads the submission, fills in an intention, and proposes tasks — effectively turning feedback into actionable work items automatically. This directly matches the PM story of converting feedback into an actionable task/intention. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and detail on PM-side editing/approval workflow before tasks are created.
